name: higher-education-institutions
title: Tertiary and TVET institutions and programmes in Uganda
description: Universities, other tertiary institutions and technical and vocational (TVET) providers on the registers of NCHE, the TVET Council and the Ministry of Education and Sports, with their accredited programmes and a dated record of how each register has changed since April 2025.

sources.title: NCHE, TVET Council and Ministry of Education and Sports

notes: Three regulators publish who may train students. The National Council for Higher Education (NCHE, unche.or.ug) licenses universities and other tertiary institutions and accredits their programmes. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Act, 2025, in force since 15 March 2025, moved the licensing of TVET providers and the accreditation of TVET programmes to a new TVET Council (tvetcs.go.ug), which publishes the private providers it has licensed. The Ministry of Education and Sports TVET department (tvet.go.ug) lists the government and registered TVET institutions it runs.

The two regulators' mandates overlap and NCHE has said the split is not settled: some institutions appear on both an NCHE and a TVET register, and NCHE marks programmes that lean towards TVET (tvetLeaning). This dataset keeps one record per institution and, separately, how each register lists it, so both views can be compared.

Each register is read on the first Monday of every month. When an institution or programme appears on, disappears from or returns to a register, the change is recorded with the date of the read that first saw it. An institution dropped by NCHE and listed by a TVET register has moved between regulators; the date is when this portal noticed, not when the regulator decided. The first record is the NCHE website as scraped on 12 April 2025.

Of the 321 institutions NCHE listed in April 2025, 141 were no longer on its register in November 2026. Eight of them now appear on a TVET register; most others are university campuses, public health training schools and military colleges that neither published TVET list includes.
knownIssues: Institutions are matched across registers by name and curated aliases, so a renamed institution may appear twice until an alias is added.
NCHE institutions are located to district level; Ministry TVET institutions to parish level where the parish name matches.
The TVET Council publishes private providers only; government TVET institutions come from the Ministry register, which lists no programmes.
Change dates are the dates of the monthly reads, so a change is dated up to a month after it happened.
Websites and email domains come from wkambale/Ug-Universities-Api (MIT licence, https://github.com/wkambale/Ug-Universities-Api) and cover universities only.

changelog.note: NCHE register of 16 July 2026 with 3,703 accredited programmes, TVET Council and Ministry TVET registers, campuses, register history and monthly updates.
Website and email domain for 43 universities, from wkambale/Ug-Universities-Api (MIT).
First publication from the NCHE website.

resources.name: institutions
resources.title: Tertiary and TVET institutions
resources.description: Every institution on the NCHE, TVET Council or Ministry TVET register since 2025-04-12, listed or not, with its current regulator, location and, for universities, website and email domain. See listings.csv for each register's own record.

fields.name: regulator
fields.description: nche or tvet: NCHE if NCHE lists it, otherwise the TVET regulators if one of their registers does, otherwise the regulator of its latest listing

fields.name: is_listed
fields.description: 1 if a register's latest read lists it

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: Institution id this campus or constituent college belongs to

fields.name: award_type
fields.description: NCHE licence or award category in the 2025-04-12 scrape

fields.name: program_link
fields.description: Link to the institution's programmes on its register

resources.name: listings
resources.title: Register listings
resources.description: One row per institution per register (nche, tvet-council, moes-tvet), with the register's own id, category, status and the first and last dates an import saw it.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Id on the register (NCHE institution_id, Ministry institute code)

fields.name: listed_name
fields.description: Name as the register lists it

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category on the register, e.g. University, OTI, ODAI, Campus, Technical College

fields.name: accreditation_status
fields.description: Licence or registration status on the register

fields.name: ownership
fields.description: Ownership as the register states it

fields.name: listed_district
fields.description: District as the register lists it

resources.name: programmes
resources.title: Accredited programmes
resources.description: Programmes on the NCHE and TVET Council registers, including ones no longer listed (see last_seen_on).

fields.name: discipline
fields.description: NCHE discipline tier, or the TVET Council sector

fields.name: tvet_leaning
fields.description: NCHE flag for programmes that lean to TVET: Yes, No or Review

fields.name: max_admissible
fields.description: Maximum admissible number of trainees (TVET Council)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Active or Inactive, as the register states

resources.name: register-changes
resources.title: Register changes
resources.description: Institutions and programmes added to, dropped from or returning to a register, dated by the import that first saw the change.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name as the register lists it

fields.name: observed_on
fields.description: Import that first saw the change

fields.name: last_seen_on
fields.description: Previous import that listed it (dropped and returned)

resources.name: register-snapshots
resources.title: Register snapshots
resources.description: Counts per register and import date, by dimension, for time series. Long format: one row per register, date, measure, dimension and value.

fields.name: source_updated_on
fields.description: Date the register says it was last updated, where it says

fields.name: dimension
fields.description: total, category, accreditation_status, ownership, sector, level, discipline, status or tvet_leaning

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value of the dimension (all for total)
